description: Get one object from the user's graph, with the objects connected to it (its edges, e.g. a person's spaces, a note's subject). Identify it by object_id (exact and preferred, search and list return it) or by name. Use this when the user asks about a specific thing in their graph, or to follow a connection you found on another object. Returns {found, object, fields, editable_fields, connected_objects, connected_total}: the record's name, description and object_id sit under object. When nothing matches, found is false with searched_for, and with matches when a name fits several objects.

object_id.description: Exact node id (e.g. web_aBc123), if known.

name: get_graph_object
title: Get brain object
